look: Art direction: the visual language of the 2D fighting game Little Fighter 2. Hand-drawn pixel-art look with crisp black outlines, flat cel colours with one darker shadow tone and one highlight, slightly chunky proportions (about five and a half heads tall), readable at small size. No photorealism, no soft gradients, no blur, no text other than the labels asked for, no logos of real brands, no watermark.

jobs.prompt: Character sprite sheet for a playable fighter named JIN. The third reference image is the previous version of this exact sheet: keep the same character, same face, same hair, same deep red tang jacket with black frog buttons and gold trim, black loose trousers, black cloth shoes, same layout, same scale and the same labels. Change only the weapon: instead of a folding fan he fights with a pair of long wooden chopsticks held in his right hand like twin daggers, and a small white rice bowl with a blue rim tucked in his left hand. Play the Chinese kung-fu movie cliches with a wink: a tiny red tassel on the chopsticks, a confident eyebrow. Plain flat solid white background, no floor, no shadows. Row 1, turnaround: FRONT, THREE-QUARTER, SIDE, BACK in the same relaxed fighting stance. Row 2, side view facing right: IDLE, WALK 1, WALK 2, ATTACK (lightning-fast double chopstick poke forward, two motion lines), SPECIAL (a blur dash pose, body leaning forward, chopsticks first, speed lines behind), HURT (leaning back, eyes shut, rice bowl flying).
